contract:
#26 Done when: a quoted evaluation passes only if the engine gave that value for that side; signed scores kept separate from move-loss figures (FR-10, NFR-6). The false-alarm sentences pass ('Your 3.Bf4 was the right London setup' after Bg3; 'White castled with O-O earlier' on Black's turn; '+1 in development'; 'nobody is 2 pawns up'), and existing rejections hold (Black O-O, '+4.2' with no tool call, 'Push h5!'). The failure message says 'a move or evaluation'.

One commit 723457a by tutor-agent (brief 035). Its summary: Evidence keeps `scores` (signed White-relative), `shown` (as a tool displayed them, evaluate_move from the mover's POV) and `deltas` (cp_loss, cpLoss/gainCp via new addDelta). backsEval takes a frame: 'white' when the quote names a side (only a signed score backs it, never a delta); 'shown' for a signed number with no side (a score with that sign as White or the mover saw it, or a delta of that size); 'magnitude' default (any |score| or delta). extractEvals(text, playerColor?) finds side from subject or trailing phrase; 'you'/'your opponent' resolved via playerColor which session.ts now passes to checkClaims. Move-number prefixes resolved against that history ply (Evidence.historyPly from FEN counters); a side named as mover right before a move limits positions to that side to move. Signed counts ('+1 in development', '+2 in space', '+1 tempo') and negated numbers in the clause's last words are not evaluations. Spoke's own findings: heuristics; bare past move that is legal now (no move number) still rejected as before.
